image_title: Improvement and Additional Gain in MATH Levels
summary: The bar and line chart illustrates the percentage improvement and additional gain across different MATH levels, labeled MATH-L1 to MATH-L5. The improvement is shown in percentage on the left axis, while the additional gain is on the right axis. The chart compares two methods: TTRL and T3RL. TTRL shows a significant improvement in MATH-L1 with a 0.8% gain, while T3RL shows a steady increase in additional gain, peaking at 8.9% in MATH-L5. The trend indicates that while TTRL has higher initial improvements, T3RL provides increasing additional gains across the levels.
